productionRequirements.format: WAV PCM16 mono 44100Hz preferred; consistent voice, no music or sound-effect answer cues
productionRequirements.reading: Read all script segments verbatim in order; do not read headings, keys or questions; preserve contrast markers and number meanings
productionRequirements.pace: Clear natural speech; target130–150 words/minute is a production guideline, not measured duration
productionRequirements.voice: Human recording or separately approved TTS; record performer/engine/version, consent/license and redistribution rights; no voice impersonation
productionRequirements.editing: Remove accidental long gaps only; no semantic cuts; assign new media version/digest for any re-recording

verificationRequirements: Check complete PCM decoding and real duration after production.
Independent named human listens to exact hashed final WAV and verifies verbatim transcript.
Record verified segment start/end timecodes and key evidence span for each affected item.
Review audibility, ambiguity, number/contrast clarity, accidental answer cues and device playback.
Approve voice/source/redistribution rights and accessibility/replay/interruption policy.
Only then record reviewer,date,hash and release approval; missing evidence fails closed.
